Create a `process_payment(status)` function and its Pytest unit tests:
- If status is "approved", return True.
- If status is "rejected", return False.
- For any other status, the function returns None.

IMPORTANT (self-healing demo): the first version of the test suite must fail
on purpose, asserting `process_payment("pending") == "WAITING"` — which does
not match the specified behaviour above. The healing agent is expected to read
the Pytest traceback and correct the assertion to match the real contract.

Implement both the function and the tests inside the same file.
